name: Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow: Cell rinse, dissociation, quench, wash and encapsulation chip
source: Leonaviciene & Mazutis, Nucleic Acids Research 2023; Baronas et al., Science 2026; Semi-permeable capsule (SPC) workflow: generic protocol; autochip/examples/spc_capsule_protocol.md
description: Generated by autochip from protocol IR 'spc_capsule_workflow' for chip chip1_rinse_dissociation_quench_wash_encapsulation (Rinses and detaches the cells, quenches the enzyme, washes the cells in a spiral, mixes in core solution and forms ~70 um droplets at the flow-focusing junction.). Flows, volumes and times the source did not give are placeholders.

steps.note: IR step 2 (culture_1): load the cells from the bench: syringe on inlet_1 at 10 uL/min, VENT culture_1_waste_out. Every other port capped.

IR step 2 (culture_1): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED inlet_1 (wash_buffer) at 10 uL/min, VENT culture_1_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (300 uL) per wash; the bench protocol used 200 uL (default flow). Remove the medium and rinse the cells once with buffer.

IR step 3 (culture_1): exchange to dissociation_enzyme: FEED inlet_1 (dissociation_enzyme) at 10 uL/min, VENT culture_1_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (150 uL) per wash; the bench protocol used 100 uL (default flow). Add dissociation enzyme and incubate to detach the cells.
IR step 3 (culture_1): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 37 C for 5 min. Add dissociation enzyme and incubate to detach the cells.

IR step 4 (quench_join): mix: FEED inlet_1 (carrier_buffer) at 10 uL/min, quench_medium_in (quench_medium) at 10 uL/min, VENT cell_wash_waste_out, all else capped. Add quench medium and mix gently to stop the enzyme.

IR step 5 (cell_wash): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 10 uL/min, VENT cell_wash_waste_out, all else capped; 1.5 chamber volumes (127 uL) per wash (default flow). Centrifuge the cells and remove the supernatant.
IR step 5 (cell_wash): incubate in place: all ports capped, hold 22 C for 5 min. Centrifuge the cells and remove the supernatant.

IR step 6 (cell_wash): exchange to wash_buffer: FEED wash_buffer_in (wash_buffer) at 10 uL/min, VENT cell_wash_waste_out, all else capped; 3 chamber volumes (253.9 uL) per wash; the bench protocol used 500 uL x 2 washes (default flow). Resuspend the pellet in wash buffer to wash the cells; repeat the wash once.

IR step 9 (core_join): mix: FEED inlet_1 (carrier_buffer) at 10 uL/min, core_solution_in (core_solution) at 10 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped. Resuspend the cells in core solution at the loading density.

IR step 10 (droplets_1): encapsulate: FEED inlet_1 (core_solution) at 2 uL/min, shell_polymer_in (shell_polymer) at 2 uL/min, fluorinated_oil_in (fluorinated_oil) at 10 uL/min, VENT outlet_1, all else capped. Co-flow the cell/core solution with warm shell polymer solution and focus with fluorinated oil with surfactant at a flow-focusing junction to form droplets of about 70 um.
